scope: Public hospital assistant conversation and read-only doctor/availability tools with booking handoff

browser.note: The first handoff test run had a navigation timing failure. Waiting for registration/sign-in navigation fixed the test; all four assistant cases then passed.

checks.translation_integrity: passed; native language review remains manual
checks.accessibility: no serious or critical axe violations in tested chat states

live_provider_smoke.input: Fictional public cardiology enquiry followed by first doctor tomorrow morning
live_provider_smoke.result: Published demo cardiologists found; follow-up date and morning filter resolved. No future slots for matching live demo profiles. Rate-limited synthesis preserved checked cards.

limits: General information uses one Groq call; doctor searches use up to two. Existing free-tier limits apply.
Four doctors and up to three offered slots per doctor are shown; searches cover the full published directory.
AI-generated prose can be mistaken; cards and booking actions use server-validated data.
Human handover, editable knowledge base, analytics and authenticated chat actions are not part of this phase.

behaviour: Same-tab general chat retained across navigation, browser Back and refresh
Public-page launcher; minimised after navigation; hidden during sign-in and booking
30-minute chat inactivity expiry; navigation and reload do not extend retention
Anonymous sign-in preserves this visit; logout, auth expiry, Clear and account changes clear history
Storage-disabled fallback retains memory across SPA navigation
Private and clinical classified requests excluded from sessionStorage

checks.mobile_contact_chat: visually inspected; no serious/critical axe violations
